# Asset slots

README hero and showcase media live here. These are **placeholders** —
generate real images post-scaffold. The repo intentionally has **no
social-preview asset**; GitHub's default repo card is used instead.

| Slot                  | Path                          | Dimensions   | Used by                          |
|-----------------------|-------------------------------|--------------|----------------------------------|
| README hero           | `hero.png`                    | ~1600×800    | `README.md` top-of-page          |
| Showcase loop         | `showcase.gif`                | ~800×450     | Linked from README "Quickstart"  |

Mirrors the asset pattern used by `CellPlateVision/.github/` and the
org-level `lambda/.github/assets/`.
